research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Dwolla is researching systems for increasing security in online transfers by maintaining anonymity of transferors, as described in 'Maintaining security in digital electronic transfers through use of a label.' Additionally, they are developing methods for transferring between accounts without requiring sensitive information, as outlined in 'Reducing information requirements in digital electronic transfers.' These areas focus on secure and efficient account-to-account payment solutions.

overview_description.description: Dwolla is a payment services provider powering innovations with sophisticated account-to-account payment solutions. Dwolla’s modern API simplifies the complex process of integrating with the various payment networks to create a single end-to-end solution–giving businesses the ability to program payments on the same day, next day or in real-time directly to bank accounts. With minimal development, start-ups to Fortune 500 companies can gain efficiency, flexibility and improved cash flow by working with Dwolla.

about_short_description.short_description: Dwolla is a fintech company powering innovations with sophisticated account-to-account payment solutions.

product.name: Dwolla Connect
product.description: A unified API platform enabling businesses to automate and streamline account-to-account payments across multiple financial institutions and payment methods.

product.name: Automated ACH Payments
product.description: An API solution to automate ACH payment initiation, return handling, and status updates, reducing manual effort and improving payment processing efficiency.

product.name: Instant Payments
product.description: A payment solution providing real-time processing and settlement of bank transfers to accelerate payment speed and liquidity.

product.name: Open Banking Services
product.description: A platform offering instant account verification, balance checks, and secure pay-by-bank transfers through unified API integrations with financial data providers.

product.name: Dwolla Sandbox Environment
product.description: A fully simulated testing environment allowing developers to safely test and validate payment integrations before production deployment.
